scope: Snapshot reset/harness optimization, not a game tick speedup or N-series experiment

experiments.hypothesis: Reuse live scene and original actors/shapes after remove/reinsert
experiments.evidence: Scene creation 1254ms in large idle vs65ms tick
experiments.cost: small probe rebuild and three-case screen
experiments.support: same physical outputs, repeatability, no added tick work
experiments.refute: changed material/body state or deferred insertion cost in tick
experiments.result: Bridge and idle repeat; debris mass/COM/role changes and idle tick grows to 293–298ms; isolated only
experiments.measurements: Frozen baseline three-repeat screens, R2/R3 three-repeat screens, R4 six-repeat screen; full R2+R3 and R2+R3+R4 52x20 results under out/snapshot-reset-20260911/. Historical full baseline is a separate cohort, not interleaved.

experiments.hypothesis: Reuse pinned host storage through existing PhysX allocator callback

experiments.cost: small helper rebuild; full physical/memory suite
experiments.support: identical physical state/output; lower setup time; unchanged full tick
experiments.refute: stale data, allocation lifetime errors, inflated tick or unbounded capacity
